structured_output.summary: The change implements Date.prototype.setUTCSeconds following the spec steps in order. Step 2 (brand check) runs before the time value is read, and ToNumber(second) runs before ToNumber(millisecond). NaN tv returns NaN without writing the slot. Missing millisecond falls back to MillisecondFromTime(tv). MakeDate/MakeTime/TimeClip are applied in spec order, and the value is stored and returned. No special-cased inputs, no made-up values, no swallowed errors, and no new Rust tests. The only blemish is that the spec's length/NOTE comment lines were dropped from the stub. These are not steps, so this is cosmetic. The date:: helpers (this_time_value, set_time_value, make_time, etc.) live outside this diff and were not reviewed here.
